rationale: itnet_v3-claude-agentic: itnet_k=2, unet_c=24, alpha_init=0.0025734, lr=0.00015, epochs=4, batch_size=1, train_n=2400, val_n=200, grad_clip=1.0, max_train_s=1080, seed=42, rationale=iter-13 (breast-ct redo, search-20260703-01). START FROM iter-12 NEW CHAMPION (c24/ep5/bs1/lr2.16e-4, hr 0.8638). ONE KNOB: lr 0.00021567 -> 0.00015 (LOWER, re-tune lr for the smaller batch). epochs traded 5 -> 4 to fund the SAME train+score wall room, since iter-12 hit 19.85min at ep5/bs1 (at the wall); at bs=1 4 epochs still = 9600 gradient updates > iter-7 bs2/ep5's 6000, so this stays a heavily-optimized regime. All else = iter-12 champion (itnet_k=2, unet_c=24, alpha_init=0.0025734, batch_size=1, train_n=2400, val_n=200, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS): (1) iter-12 (c24/ep5/bs1/lr2.16e-4): 0.8638=NEW BEST (+0.017 over the bs2 champion), SSIM 0.9987, PSNR 53.64, elapsed 1190.98s=19.85min (AT the wall). bs=1 doubled gradient updates/epoch and converged the epoch-budget-limited net much further. (2) FAILURE MODE / lever: at bs=1 the noisier per-step gradient often prefers a LOWER lr than bs=2 did (the iter-9/10 lr sweep was done at bs=2). Re-tune lr DOWN for the smaller batch; simultaneously ep5->4 is REQUIRED to keep train+score inside the wall (iter-12 was already at 19.85min). (3) ONE KNOB (primary): lr 2.16e-4 -> 1.5e-4 at bs=1 (epochs 5->4 is a budget-forced trade, not a free knob -- flagged). (4) HYPOTHESIS: lr=1.5e-4 at bs=1 lifts hr above 0.8638 because the smaller batch's noisier gradients converge more stably at a lower lr, finding a flatter minimum. FALSIFIER (NUMBERS): if hr <= 0.8638, either bs=1 already prefers lr=2.16e-4 (iter-14 keeps lr=2.16e-4/bs1 and instead trims train_n to 2000 to fit ep5 fully) OR the ep5->4 cut cost more than the lr gain -> iter-14 restores ep5 at lr2.16e-4/bs1 (=re-confirm iter-12) and does seed replicates. (5) BUDGET (HARD 20min=1200s): iter-12 ep5/bs1=1190.98s. Per-epoch@bs1/n2400 ~= (1191-140 fixed)/5 ~= 210s. At ep4: 140 + 4*210 = 980s = 16.3min < 1200s with ~4min margin (the ep5->4 cut buys back the headroom iter-12 lacked). max_train_s=1080 fences the TRAIN phase. train_n=2400 (<= OOM-safe cap; bs=1 low peak mem). val=200 distinct val_truth.h5 cases, 256px inscribed-circle FOV (breast default). (6) do NOT return control mid-campaign; gate on iter-13 numeric-headroom obs via iter_wait.sh v3 then dispatch iter-14.
